# dart-http

Protocol-neutral HTTP packages for Dart maintained by Hippolabs.

## Package map

- `packages/sse_helpers`: bounded, incremental Server-Sent Events wire model, encoder, and decoder.

## Dependency direction

Packages in this repository must remain independent of application frameworks and HTTP runtimes.
Dart Edge, Hippobase, and applications may depend on these packages, never the reverse.

## Validation

Run `dart pub get` followed by `dart run melos run ci` from the repository root.
